message.content: {"facts": ["cutting-edge technologies in robotics include soft robots, swarm robotics, humanoid robots, autonomous robots, wearable robots, and brain-computer interfaces.", "ethics boards or committees are established to review and assess the potential ethical implications of research projects or products before they are released into the market.", "ethical codes of conduct or best practices are developed to guide researchers, designers, and users on the responsible and ethical use of robotics technology.", "the Partnership on AI (PAI) is established to promote the responsible and ethical use of AI and robotics in society.", "penalties for violating data privacy regulations could include significant financial penalties or legal action if sensitive information is compromised.", "reputation damage can serve as a deterrent for those who might consider engaging in unethical practices with robotics technology."]}
